snippet.title: Dwarf Fortress Siege Update - Out Now - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The Siege Update for Dwarf Fortress is OUT NOW!. Buy on Steam: https://bit.ly/2PY0P0w

The Siege Update brings new features to Dwarf Fortress that have never been experienced before. New enemy behaviours, weapons and improvement that makes defending your fort even more deadly. 

Music: Sisters of War - Dabu, Simon Swerwer
Cover art: Thea Kent

➫Join the Official Dwarf Fortress Discord: https://bit.ly/3W1HvfX
➫Sign up for Dwarf Mail: https://bit.ly/3uYfudW
